target_customer: ML and data engineering teams at AI companies, robotics and autonomous vehicle firms processing images, video, audio and text at scale
problem: Data platforms like Databricks and Snowflake were built for tabular analytics, so teams waste months on brittle infrastructure for petabytes of multimodal data.
business_model: Open source engine (Daft, Apache 2.0) with a commercial cloud platform (Eventual Cloud waitlist opened June 2025)
product_category: Multimodal data processing engine and distributed dataframe

founders.name: Sammy Sidhu
education: BS Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, UC Berkeley
founders.background_notes: YC page also lists high frequency trading and medical AI research at Berkeley.

founders.name: Jay Chia
education: Deep learning and computational biology research, Cornell University
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page. Degree not stated.

competitors.name: Apache Spark (Databricks)
competitors.what: Dominant distributed dataframe and SQL engine

technical_complexity.rationale: A Rust core distributed query engine handling images, video and GPU workloads with failure handling is hard for a two person team in 2022.

defensibility.rationale: Open source adoption and deep pipeline integration build switching costs, but the engine is open and rivals can fork or compete with Ray Data.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent acquisition reported as of 2026 sources. Daft remains an independent open source project.

market_need_then: AI workloads in 2022 moved toward images, video and embeddings, which tabular data platforms handled poorly. The founders hit this problem at Lyft Level 5 (TechCrunch coverage 2025).

branding.domain_note: Package renamed from getdaft to daft at v0.5.0; site moved from getdaft.io to daft.ai.

rebrands.why: Simplified package name at v0.5.0 per release note

branding.community_and_virality: Open source project with conference talks (PyData 2022, SciPy 2024, MLOps Community 2024); no merch or fan accounts found.

brand_strength.rationale: Daft is known in data engineering circles via open source and talks, but no press on the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Eventual built Daft as open source and let usage lead, with customers like Amazon and Together AI named by 2025. It raised a $7.5M seed led by CRV and a $20M Series A led by Felicis in June 2025, about three years after YC. The multimodal AI data wave and the founders' autonomous vehicle data background fit the timing.
notes: Total reported about $30M (Sidhu) versus $27.5M in one source. Seed date is the announcement date with the Series A, the actual close date is not given. Competitor comparison page is the company's own and undated; GitHub repo was created 2022-04-25. Daft name origin not found.
